subject: learning/local-ci-throughput
statement: The source code-gate runs one race-instrumented, repository-wide coverage suite and schedules memory reconciliation alongside that suite after cheap checks pass.
intent: Keep the complete local CI gate under seven minutes without dropping race detection, per-file coverage, or memory verification.
rationale: Two concurrent full Go test invocations repeated the real-Git fixtures and contended for CPU and disk. The history-wide memory check is independent of the test suite and can run in another required phase-two group.
fit_criterion: A fresh local code-gate run passes every required check in under seven minutes; CI parity verifies equivalent GitHub and Forgejo phase-two groups, and a race fixture makes the combined coverage command fail on a data race.

provenance.note: Local CI timing and combined test verification on 2026-09-24.
